title: pentameris aurea subsp. pilosogluma
intro: Pentameris aurea subsp. pilosogluma, commonly known as a species of grass, is a plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, and its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Pentameris aurea subsp. pilosogluma include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial actions, making it a popular remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
